statement: Linux xpad.c identifies 045e:028e as wired XTYPE_XBOX360 and 045e:0719 as XTYPE_XBOX360W with D-pad button mapping. It is a USB driver for vendor-specific Xbox interface classification and is not invoked merely because a UHID device uses Xbox-like VID/PID.

applicability.revision: pinned community Free60 ab1fe19, protoR2 4c0d062, x360w a8ac630; Linux 4056b3c; SDL 535d80b and 829a65d; retail revision unknown
applicability.scope: xpad.c 118-132, 477-503, 2103-2112; a standard-HID UHID device has no USB interface for xpad to bind. Consumer binding fact, not device descriptor proof.
